race.comment: MARKOS PORT (2) drops back from 1800m after just battling over that trip late last time out. He is edging closer to a maiden win, and can get the job done this time. Follow your money. ARANTU (7) caught the eye with a late finish for fourth on debut, and this late-maturing 4YO mare will relish the step up in distance. Keep her safe in all combos. AIDA (5) resumed with a strong late finish for fourth at Rosehill a month ago, and if she can settle over 1550m, then she is worth including. SNITZEL'S GIRL (11) good effort last time when she finished just 2.5 lengths away in fifth over 1400m at Warwick Farm. JMac always a danger.
